Spare Parts * Auxiliary Power * Control Systems }} | website = {{URL|https://greavescotton.com/}} }} '''Greaves Cotton Ltd.''' is an Indian [[Conglomerate (company)|conglomerate]] engineering company that manufactures [[clean technology]] [[powertrain]] products for [[Petrol engine|petrol]], [[Diesel engine|diesel]] and [[Gas engine|CNG]] engines and heavy equipment (automotive and non-automotive).{{Cite web |last=Mudholkar |first=Niranjan |date=15 Nov 2019 |title=In the right direction |url=https://www.themachinist.in/worldwidemedia/interviews/5924/direction |access-date=2023-12-21 |website=Themachinist.in |language=en}}{{Cite web |last=Sachdev |first=Alisha |date=2023-05-31 |title=Greaves diversifies business as e-mobility drives revenue |url=https://www.livemint.com/news/india/greaves-cotton-s-electric-mobility-division-drives-revenue-growth-balances-diversification-with-ic-components-and-non-automotive-businesses-11685554700384.html |access-date=2024-02-16 |website=mint |language=en}} The company is traded on the [[National Stock Exchange of India]] (NSE) and the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] (BSE). The company had 200 distributors, a total of 8,000 retail stores and 20,000 mechanics present all over India in October 2023.{{Cite web |last=Ahmed |first=Aroosa |date=2023-10-01 |title=Greaves Retail to expand overseas presence |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/greaves-retail-to-expand-overseas-presence/article67360854.ece |access-date=2023-12-21 |website=BusinessLine |language=en}} == History == The company was founded in 1859 by James Greaves and George Cotton. It was incorporated in 1922 as a private limited company.{{Cite web|url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/greaves-cotton-ltd/infocompanyhistory/companyid-13698.cms|title=The Economic Times|website=economictimes.indiatimes.com|access-date=2017-02-21}} Greaves Cotton was purchased by Lala [[Karam Chand Thapar]] of the [[Thapar Group]] in 1947.{{cite web |url=http://www.greavescotton.com/CorporateProfile/milestone.aspx |title=Milestones |publisher=Greaves Cotton Ltd |accessdate=13 July 2013}} It was converted into a public limited company in 1950. In FY2013, the company reported a growth of 6.84% with ₹1,873 crore compared to FY2012 with ₹1,753 crore.{{Cite web |last= |title=Greaves Cotton foresees subdued biz for 3-4 quarters |url=https://www.deccanherald.com/business/greaves-cotton-foresees-subdued-biz-2289840 |access-date=2023-12-21 |website=Deccan Herald |language=en}} In May 2019, the company launched a high-speed electric scooter named Ampere Zeal that meets the specifications of the Faster Adoption and Manufacturing of Electric Vehicles (FAME) II policy of the Indian government. The e-scooter Zeal has a top speed of 55 kmph and a range of 75 km on a one-time charge of 5.5 hours.{{Cite news |last= |first= |date=2019-05-28 |title=Greaves Cotton launches high speed e-scooter Ampere Zeal |language=en-IN |work=The Hindu |url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/Industry/greaves-cotton-launches-high-speed-e-scooter-ampere-zeal/article27278548.ece |access-date=2023-12-21 |issn=0971-751X}} In FY2019, the company reported a growth of 11% with ₹1,988 crore as compared to last year with ₹1,790 crore.{{Cite web |last=Panday |first=Amit |date=2019-05-27 |title=Greaves Cotton to foray into electric vehicle battery manufacturing |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/greaves-cotton-to-foray-into-electric-vehicle-battery-manufacturing-1558946938507.html |access-date=2023-12-21 |website=mint |language=en}} In Dec 2020, due to Indian government emission norms from [[Bharat stage emission standards#Background information|BS4 to BS6]], the company shut down its [[Ranipet]], [[Tamil Nadu]] plant as part of its exercise for consolidation of plants and shifted all the operations to [[Aurangabad|the Aurangabad]] plant.{{Cite web |last=James |first=Nandana |date=2021-02-12 |title=Greaves Cotton to continue investments towards diversification: Group CEO & MD |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/greaves-cotton-to-continue-investments-towards-diversification-group-ceo-md/article33816652.ece |access-date=2023-12-21 |website=BusinessLine |language=en}} In Sep 2021, the company launched its first multi-brand electric vehicle (EV) retail store named AutoEVmart in Bengaluru with 8,000 sqft space which has e-vehicles, retrofitted accessories and after-sales for electric car experience.{{Cite web |last=Bhatia |first=Shubhangi |date=29 Sep 2021 |title=Greaves Cotton looking for investors to scale up e-mobility biz - ET Auto |url=https://auto.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/two-wheelers/greaves-cotton-open-to-welcoming-investors-to-scale-up-mobility-business/86611610 |access-date=2023-12-21 |website=ETAuto.com |language=en}} In Aug 2023, Greaves Retail, a part of the group, launched a range of batteries for an e-rickshaw named Power Raja.{{Cite web |date=2023-08-29 |title=Greaves Cotton gains on launch of new e-rickshaw batteries |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/stocks/greaves-cotton-gains-on-launch-of-new-e-rickshaw-batteries-11276861.html |access-date=2023-12-21 |website=Moneycontrol |language=en}} In FY2023, Greaves Electric Mobility (GEM), a part of the group solely earned revenue from ₹2,700 crores contributing 42% of its total revenue that was ₹6,429 crore.{{Cite web |last=Sachdev |first=Alisha |date=2023-05-31 |title=Greaves diversifies business as e-mobility drives revenue |url=https://www.livemint.com/news/india/greaves-cotton-s-electric-mobility-division-drives-revenue-growth-balances-diversification-with-ic-components-and-non-automotive-businesses-11685554700384.html |access-date=2023-12-21 |website=mint |language=en}} ==Products== The company produces powertrains for diesel, petrol, kerosene and gasoline engines, diesel pump sets, [[Diesel generator|gensets]], farm equipment, e-mobility and aftermarket spares and services. It supplies mechanical and electronic motion control systems.{{Cite news |last=Mukherjee |first=Sharmistha |date=2024-01-24 |title=Excel Controlinkage targets trebling revenues to Rs 500 crore |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/indl-goods/svs/engineering/excel-controlinkage-targets-trebling-revenues-to-rs-500-crore/articleshow/107104674.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2024-02-06 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}} == Greaves Cotton group companies == * Greaves Electric Mobility - designing and manufacturing of two and three wheelers electric vehicles * Greaves Finance Limited - financing solutions for electric vehicles * Greaves Retail and Distribution - retail and servicing for e3W, ICE 3W, and SCV ** Retail company exports its spares parts to [[Sri Lanka]] and [[Bangladesh]].{{Cite web |last=Ahmed |first=Aroosa |date=2023-10-01 |title=Greaves Retail to expand overseas presence |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/greaves-retail-to-expand-overseas-presence/article67360854.ece |access-date=2023-12-21 |website=BusinessLine |language=en}} * Greaves Technologies Limited - engineering research and development and digital services * Greaves Engineering - fuel agnostic powertrain solutions (auto and non-auto) == Investments and acquisitions == In Oct 2018, the group first invested ₹77 crore in Coimbatore-based electric vehicle (EV) manufacturer Ampere Vehicles by acquiring a 67.34% stake. Within a year, the company again invested ₹38.49 crore and increased the stakes to 81.23% in Jul 2019.{{Cite web |last=Panday |first=Amit |date=2019-07-15 |title=Greaves Cotton hikes stake in EVs maker Ampere Vehicles to 81.23% |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/greaves-cotton-hikes-stake-in-evs-maker-ampere-vehicles-to-81-23-1563195277361.html |access-date=2023-12-21 |website=mint |language=en}} Greaves Cotton wholly owned the Coimbatore-based electric vehicle manufacturer Ampere Electric Vehicles. The acquisition marked the entry into the ever-booming EV industry.{{cite news |date=14 January 2020 |title=Ampere Vehicles & Greaves Cotton Parents Innovation |work=Ampere Electric Vehicles |url=https://amperevehicles.com/about/ |accessdate=29 January 2020}} In Jun 2021, the company signed an MoU with the Tamil Nadu government to invest about ₹700 crore over ten years for a plant with an annual capacity of 1 million units, with the initial production capacity being 1 lakh units per annum.{{Cite web |last=Baggonkar |first=Swaraj |date=2021-06-24 |title=Greaves Cotton looks to launch high-speed electric two-wheelers in two years |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/technology/auto/greaves-cotton-looks-to-launch-high-speed-electric-two-wheelers-in-two-years-7081851.html |access-date=2023-12-21 |website=Moneycontrol |language=en}}{{Cite news |last=Mishra |first=Lalatendu |date=2021-10-02 |title=Goal is to create ecosystem for EVs: Greaves Cotton MD |language=en-IN |work=The Hindu |url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/Industry/goal-is-to-create-ecosystem-for-evs-greaves-cotton-md/article36797911.ece |access-date=2023-12-21 |issn=0971-751X}} In Feb 2023, the company announced the agreement by signing the binding terms to acquire a 100% stake through multiple tranches in Excel ControLinkage Pvt. Ltd.{{Cite news |last=Mishra |first=Lalatendu |date=2023-04-08 |title=Greaves Cotton Ltd., enters agreement to acquire Excel Controlinkage |language=en-IN |work=The Hindu |url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/greaves-cotton-ltd-enters-agreement-to-acquire-excel-controlinkage/article66713897.ece |access-date=2023-12-21 |issn=0971-751X}} The acquisition will cost ₹385 crore and it will be completed in four phases.{{Cite web |date=2023-04-08 |title=Greaves Cotton to acquire Excel ControLinkage for Rs 385 cr |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/greaves-cotton-to-acquire-excel-controlinkage-for-rs-385-cr/article66713612.ece |access-date=2023-12-21 |website=BusinessLine |language=en}} == Partnership == In Oct 2017, the group company strategically partnered with US and Bengaluru-based start-up company Altigreen Propulsion Labs to provide a range of clean energy powertrain solutions for three-wheeler and micro four-wheeler commercial vehicles.{{Cite web |date=2017-12-14 |title=Greaves Cotton prepares for new mobility landscape |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/specials/auto-focus/greaves-cotton-prepares-for-new-mobility-landscape/article9994062.ece |access-date=2023-12-21 |website=BusinessLine |language=en}}{{Cite web |date=4 Oct 2017 |title=Greaves Cotton rises after tie up with Altigreen Propulsion Labs |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-cm/greaves-cotton-rises-after-tie-up-with-altigreen-propulsion-labs-117100400341_1.html |access-date=21 Dec 2023 |website=Business-standard.com}} In Jan 2023, the group company partnered with UK-based electric drive system design company Eta Green Power to share the rights of their technology in the Indian two and three-wheeler segment.{{Cite news |last=Sen Gupta |first=Nandini |date=2023-01-27 |title=Greaves Cotton ties up with UK firm Eta Green Power for electric drive system |work=The Times of India Greaves Cotton Ltd. is an Indian conglomerate engineering company that manufactures clean technology powertrain products for petrol, diesel and CNG engines and heavy equipment (automotive and non-automotive). The company is traded on the National Stock Exchange of India (NSE) and the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE).
The company had 200 distributors, a total of 8,000 retail stores and 20,000 mechanics present all over India in October 2023.
